name: 35551-randomdecode-gptoss120b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One engine, one GPU, no sharding; expert parallelism is meaningless at one GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=32, request-rate inf, bounded at 640 requests with a 900 s safety cap, 5% warmup and 5% cooldown declared off each end.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix reuse: prompt EXACTLY 128 tokens and output EXACTLY 256 (min = max on both), `request_format: plain`, `temperature: 0.0`, Faker-generated English prompts, seed 35551.
purpose: A long-form answer generator for 32 concurrent users, short prompts and fixed 256-token replies on one GPU.
launch:
# One engine on one H100 80GB HBM3, TP=1.
# HAZARD -- HBM capacity binds: 60.77 GiB of MXFP4 weights against a 79.65 GiB card. If the
# engine refuses to allocate a KV cache, raise this value rather than swapping the checkpoint.
model: openai/gpt-oss-120b
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 64
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
